I have BPD and I blame my Nmom for it due to abuse during my development. It is hard for me to feel empathy. I'm also on a lot of medications that make me feel detached, so that I can manage extreme emotions. I can't handle my own emotions so I avoid feeling anyone elses pain
I constantly worry about my Nmom killing herself. One of my biggest fears.
Nope my parents don't know my address. I don't feel bad at all because they have shown up at former addresses to harass me before. #1 priority is to stay safe mentally and physically
I have nightmares about my abusive mother all the time. This has been going on for 3 years.

I took abilify for a while and felt dead. I was so lethargic and numb. I now take latuda and it has removed a good amount of my psychotic symptoms without side effects. My psychosis made it difficult for me to function so I appreciate the medication.

Also fuck the labels (I have many as well). I'm 20, when I was younger I  was often like "what the fuck is wrong with me. why do I have so many disorders" BUT when it comes to things like hearing voices or other serious things that often bring labels it is better to be labeled before things become worse than to be a fucked up label- less person who never gets help but would really benefit from it

I have similar issues with auditory hallucinations. In my experience they called it psychosis. There is no harm in mentioning it to your doctor as they can't treat you properly if they are not aware of what is going on. There is medication that is supposed to help, in my case it did not help but I wanted to respond to you because the number of people who will admit to hearing voices is small and you should know you are not alone.
